1.title: Gate of Hell: Rise of Demons
1.description: An intense action survival game where you must hold back the tides of hell.
1.fullDescription:
The gates of hell have opened, and thousands of demons are pouring onto the surface. As humanity's last bastion, you must stop the relentless enemies and close the gate at the heart of hell.
      This game combines intense pixel graphics with thrilling action in a survival tower defense format. New enemies appear with each wave, and players can upgrade their weapons and defenses using collected Soul Stones.
      Strategic placement and quick decision-making are the keys to victory. Can you overcome the horrors of hell and save humanity? Take on the challenge now!
      As the commander of the Night's Watch, you are entrusted with the most dangerous mission in human history. The Breach, a dimensional tear in the center of the Old City, is spewing forth entities that defy biological logic.
      You must manage a limited supply of enchanted essence to build arcane towers and equip your soldiers with blessed weaponry. Each demon you slay releases a Soul Fragment, the only currency that matters in this dying world.
      Use these fragments to research forgotten technologies and call down orbital strikes from the last remaining satellite weapon, the "Aegis-7". The survival of our species depends on your tactical brilliance.
1.controls: Mouse Click: Attack and select upgrades / Drag: Place defensive structures
1.tips: Focus on upgrading your fire rate early. Positioning your towers near the chokepoints is the key to surviving the later waves. Don't spend all your Soul Fragments at once; keep some for emergency orbital strikes when the Elite Demons appear in Wave 10.
1.lore:
In the year 2099, a group of scientists attempted to tap into a subterranean energy source, only to discover it was a prison for the oldest entities in the universe.
      The "Lords of the Pit" had been trapped for eons, fed only by the echoes of human sorrow. When the drill pierced the final seal, they didn't just walk out—they tore the reality around them.
      The Old City was the first to fall, its skyscrapers becoming monuments to despair. But in the shadows, a secret order known as the "Scribes of the Flame" had been preparing for this day for centuries.
      They infused modern technology with ancient runes, creating the weapons you now wield. The battle isn't just for territory; it's for the very soul of the planet.
features: Deep Tech Tree for Permanent Power-ups

2.title: Galaxy Launch: Infinite Fleet
2.description: An addictive clicker game where you expand your fleet and conquer the galaxy.
2.fullDescription:
Create a new fleet at the edge of the vast universe and become the ruler of the galaxy. Galaxy Launch starts with simple clicks but offers deep strategic management as your empire grows.
      Extract resources from planets and research cutting-edge technology to enhance your ships' firepower. Watching hundreds of ships fly through space in real-time is a unique thrill found only in clicker games.
      Test your limits in infinite space, upgrade your space station, and venture into further galaxies. The peace—or conquest—of the galaxy is entirely in your hands.
      As the Grand Admiral of the Neo-Terran Hegemony, you are tasked with the Great Expansion. Your starting point is the "Vanguard Station," a derelict refinery on the edge of the Andromeda Galaxy.
      You must optimize the ship-to-resource ratio, balancing the production of mining drones with heavy interceptors. The galaxy is not empty; pirate factions and rogue AI swarms will attempt to intercept your cargo.
      Unlock the "Dyson Swarm" project to harness the full power of nearby stars, allowing for the construction of Dreadnought-class vessels that can dominate entire star systems.
2.controls: Left Click: Collect resources / Menu Buttons: Buy upgrades and ships
2.tips: Automate your resource collection as soon as possible. Researching "Hyper-drive" early will significantly boost your expansion speed. Don't forget to upgrade your Station shields, as the pirate raids become much more frequent after you conquer your third planet.
2.lore:
The year is 4022. Earth is a distant memory, a myth shared by travelers in the deep void. Humanity now lives in the "Flotilla," a massive collection of interconnected ships wandering the stars.
      But resources are dwindling, and the internal factions are on the brink of civil war. Your mission, sanctioned by the Elder Council, is to find the "Primal Star"—a legendary sun that never dies.
      To reach it, you must navigate through the Great Barrier, a region of space filled with ancient debris and gravitational anomalies. You are the last hope for a civilization that has forgotten how to call a planet "home".
features: Over 50 Unique Ship Types to Unlock
Prestige System: "Galaxy Jump" for Permanent Multipliers
Visual Upgrades for your Space Station

3.title: Idle Avatar RPG
3.description: Develop your own avatar and explore a mysterious world that grows automatically.
3.fullDescription:
The best choice for those who want the fun of growth even in a busy daily life: Idle Avatar RPG. Even while you sleep, your avatar fights monsters, acquires precious items, and grows stronger.
      Combine various classes and skill trees to create your own unique hero. Hundreds of equipment sets and gem enhancement systems provide endless nurturing fun.
      Mysterious dungeon exploration, boss raids, and a ranking system to compete with players worldwide! Experience the comfort of an idle game and the depth of an RPG simultaneously.
      Enter the realm of Aethelgard, a world where thought shapes reality. You play as a Soul-Binder, a rare individual capable of projecting their consciousness into powerful Avatars.
      Your physical body remains in the Temple of Stasis, but your Avatar roams the Wildlands, battling the Shadow-Blight that threatens to consume the world's remaining light.
      Gather "Echo Dust" from defeated foes to attune your Avatar to the elements—Fire, Ice, and Void. The deeper you venture into the Wildlands, the more complex the loot becomes, requiring you to master the art of Enchanting.
3.controls: Auto-battle supported / Click: Manual skill use and equipment management
3.tips: Keep an eye on the "Rebirth" mechanic. Resetting your progress at the right time provides massive permanent bonuses. Prioritize the "Luck" stat early on to increase the drop rate of Rare-tier equipment from low-level goblins.
3.lore:
Aethelgard was once a unified paradise, governed by the "Great Weavers" who spun the threads of fate. But a catastrophic event known as the "Unraveling" broke the loom, scattering the threads across the void.
      Now, the world exists as fragmented islands of reality, held together only by the will of the Soul-Binders. The Shadow-Blight is the manifestation of the void's hunger to erase what remains.
      Every piece of equipment you find is a relic from the old world, a solidified memory of a civilization that was once perfect. By wearing them, you are literally wearing history itself.
features: True Offline Progress: Gains while App is Closed
Complex Class Tree with over 20 Specializations
Global Raid Bosses with Massive Rewards
Pet System: Tame Monsters to Fight Alongside You

5.title: GEM MERGE
5.description: A strategic puzzle game where you merge colorful gems to create bigger ones.
5.fullDescription:
Challenge your spatial thinking and reflexes in GEM MERGE! Drop vibrant gems into the container and merge identical ones to evolve them into more valuable jewels.
      Plan your moves carefully to prevent the container from overflowing. How high can you score before the gems reach the top? Compete with others on the leaderboard and prove your merging mastery!
      Step into the shoes of a Master Alchemist in the Celestial Laboratory. Your task is to refine the Primal Gems, raw manifestations of magical energy, into the legendary "Philosopher's Stone."
      The container is enchanted with "Gravity-Null," meaning the gems behave with realistic physics, bouncing and rolling in unpredictable ways. 
      You must account for the weight and friction of each gem type. Merging gems doesn't just increase your score—it releases a burst of pure energy that can nudge other gems, potentially creating chain reactions or catastrophic overflows.
5.controls: Mouse/Touch: Drag to aim and release to drop gems.
5.tips: Large gems at the bottom, small gems at the top. Use the "Shake" feature wisely when you are in a tight spot. Watch for the "Next Gem" preview—sometimes it's better to drop a small gem in a corner to wait for a larger merge opportunity later.
5.lore:
The Crystal Caves hold treasures beyond imagination. Only those with the sharpest minds can master the art of gem resonance.
      Long ago, the "Great Gem-Smiths" used these gems to power the floating cities of Sky-Reach. But when the cities fell, the knowledge was lost, and the gems scattered.
      Now, you are the first seeker to find the Alchemist's Vessel, the only container capable of stabilizing the raw power of merged gems. 
      Each tier of gem represents a different stage of celestial evolution, from simple Quartz to the universe-defining Star-Core.
features: Multiple Game Modes: Classic, Speed, and Zen
Stunning Visual Effects and Particle Systems
Adaptive Soundscape that Changes with your Score

6.title: Trade Tycoon - Civilization
6.description: Build your empire, trade resources, and lead your civilization to prosperity.
6.fullDescription:
Experience the thrill of building a civilization from the ground up in Trade Tycoon. Manage resources, establish trade routes, and make strategic decisions to expand your influence across the globe.
      This game is currently in production, bringing deep economic simulation and city-building elements to your browser. Stay tuned for more updates!
      In the dawn of the Bronze Age, you are the leader of a small coastal tribe. Your journey begins with simple barter, but your ambition is to create a Silk Road that spans continents.
      You must manage the "Happiness-Tax" balance, ensuring your citizens are productive while keeping the treasury full for military expansion.
      The world is a living marketplace; prices of gold, spices, and iron fluctuate based on global supply and demand. Will you be a peaceful merchant prince or a ruthless conqueror who controls the world's resources through force?
6.controls: Mouse: Navigate menus and manage city structures.
6.tips: Balance your production and consumption. Over-expansion can lead to a resource crisis. Always keep a surplus of "Grain" for the winter months, as production drops and prices skyrocket during the off-season.
6.lore:
From humble beginnings to a global superpower. Your dynasty will be remembered for centuries to come.
      The legends tell of the "First Merchant," who traded a single pearl for a ship, and that ship for a kingdom. 
      But history is written by the victors. In this world, the gods only smile upon those who can provide the finest offerings of silk and wine.
      Your civilization's rise is written in the ledgers of time, where every coin earned is a brick in your eternal monument.
features: Multiple Tech Eras from Bronze to Space
Procedural World Maps with Unique Resources
Customizable City Layouts for Optimized Production

7.title: 15s Click Challenge
7.description: Test your clicking speed in this intense 15-second challenge!
7.fullDescription:
How fast are your fingers? 15s Click Challenge is the ultimate test of speed and endurance. You have exactly 15 seconds to click the target as many times as possible. 
      Track your Total Clicks and Clicks Per Second (CPS) to see how you rank among the world's fastest clickers. Can you break the record and claim the top spot? 
      This is not just a game; it's a high-octane reflex training simulation used by elite esports athletes. The target's hitbox is precision-tuned to detect the slightest input lag.
      Every click is registered on our ultra-low latency servers, ensuring that your raw performance is captured without interference.
      In the final 5 seconds, the "Overdrive" mode activates, pulsing the screen with light and sound to test your focus under pressure.
7.controls: Mouse: Left-click the target as fast as you can.
7.tips: Use your wrist for speed, but don't forget to breathe! Consistency is better than a sudden burst followed by fatigue. Try a "Jitter Click" or "Butterfly Click" technique used by pro players to break the 10 CPS barrier.
7.lore:
In the digital arena, speed is everything. Can you join the ranks of the Lightning Clickers?
      The myth of the "One-Thousand Clicker" has persisted since the early days of the internet. They say once you reach a certain speed, time itself begins to slow down.
      This simulation was built by the "Latency Architects" to find the fastest biological inputs on the planet. Are you a mere mortal, or are your reflexes truly superhuman?

8.title: OMOK
8.description: A masterpiece of strategy and intuition. Master the ancient art of Five-in-a-Row.
8.fullDescription:
Experience the timeless elegance of Omok, the classic abstract strategy board game known worldwide as Gomoku. Simple to learn but offering infinite strategic depth, Omok challenges you to align five stones in a row—horizontally, vertically, or diagonally—before your opponent does.
      Every move is a delicate balance between offense and defense. Will you build your own unstoppable sequence, or will you focus on anticipating and blocking your rival's every turn? 
      Whether you are a casual player looking for a quick mental workout or a strategy enthusiast seeking a true competitive challenge, Omok provides a pure, minimalist gaming experience that tests the limits of your foresight and tactical skill.
      Play against a sophisticated AI calibrated to the styles of legendary masters. Every game is a lesson in patience and geometric vision.
8.controls: Mouse Click: Place a stone on the board.
8.tips: Control the center. Always look for "Open Threes" and plan at least two steps ahead of your opponent. If your opponent has an open four, the game is already over—prevent it before it happens!
8.lore:
A game of kings and scholars. The black and white stones represent the harmony and conflict of the universe.
      The origin of Omok is lost to time, but some say it was played by the gods to decide the boundaries of the stars. 
      The board itself is a map of the soul, where every stone represents a decision, and the lines represent the paths we choose to follow.
      To win is not just to align five stones, but to demonstrate a superior understanding of the balance between creation and destruction.
features: Advanced AI with Multiple Difficulty Levels
Replay System to Analyze your Previous Games
Customizable Board Skins and Stone Styles
Leaderboard for Win Rates and Elo Rating

9.title: 40th Century: Void Survivor
9.description: Survive in the void of the 40th century. Battle cosmic horrors and collect ancient artifacts.
9.fullDescription:
Step into the desolate 40th century where humanity fights for survival in the vast emptiness of the void. 40th Century: Void Survivor is an intense action-survival game that challenges your reflexes and strategic thinking.
      Navigate through waves of cosmic horrors, upgrading your ship and abilities as you progress. Collect mysterious artifacts and antiques that grant powerful bonuses and reveal the history of a lost civilization.
      The further you go, the more dangerous the void becomes. Can you reach the final stage and become the ultimate survivor?
      You are the pilot of the "Void-Walker," a craft capable of dipping in and out of the lightless dimension. Your fuel is the very essence of the horrors you destroy.
      The game utilizes a "Quantum Upgrade" system, where every level-up presents you with three random paths to power. Will you focus on kinetic projectiles or esoteric energy beams?
9.controls: WASD/Arrow Keys: Move / Mouse: Aim and Fire / Space: Special Ability
9.tips: Mobility is survival. Never stay in one spot for more than 3 seconds. Prioritize artifact collection to gain early power-ups. Some artifacts synergize—look for the "Void-Heart" and "Singularity-Core" combo for devastating area damage.
9.lore:
The stars have gone dark. In the silence of the 40th century, the Void whispers. Only the bravest can hear the path to salvation.
      The "Solar Extinction" was not a natural event; it was a harvest. The entities from the Void returned to claim what they planted billions of years ago.
      Humanity's last cities are built on the hulls of dead suns, protected only by the thinning layers of reality. You are a scavenger of the void, searching for the "Omega Code," the only thing capable of rebooting the universe.
features: Procedurally Generated Waves and Enemy Patterns
Unlockable Ships with Different Base Stats

10.title: Endless War: Holy vs Hell
10.description: An epic simulation of the eternal conflict between heaven and hell.
10.fullDescription:
The eternal conflict between the forces of Holy and Hell has reached a new peak. In Endless War: Holy vs Hell, you witness and influence the tide of battle in this grand simulation. 
      Strategize and manage your resources as you progress through countless waves of enemies. How many waves can you survive? How many battles can you conquer? 
      Experience high-stakes simulation and test your tactical prowess in the ultimate struggle for cosmic balance.
      You play as the "Arbiter," a neutral entity tasked with maintaining the equilibrium of the afterlife. Your interface allows you to direct the souls of the fallen into either the Golden Army of the Heavens or the Infernal Legion of the Abyss.
      The game uses a "Macro-Management" system, where you don't control individual soldiers, but rather the divine laws and tactical formations of entire legions.
10.controls: Mouse: Navigate menus / Keyboard: Hotkeys for unit management
10.tips: Diversify your army. A mix of ranged and melee units is essential to counter the evolving enemy waves. Don't ignore the "Karma" meter; keeping it centered grants you the "Divine Storm" ability, which can clear an entire screen of enemies.
10.lore:
Since the beginning of time, two powers have vied for supremacy. Today, you decide which side tips the scale.
      The war started when the "First Archon" and the "Primal Demon" disagreed on the destiny of mortal souls. 
      This disagreement turned into a conflict that has lasted billions of years, consuming entire galaxies in its wake.
      The battlefield is the "Threshold," a plane of existence where time and space are malleable. Here, the echoes of every prayer and every sin take physical form as warriors.
features: Over 30 Divine and Infernal Unit Types
Dynamic Battlefield Events: Solar Flares and Abyssal Rifts

11.title: Dicefall Chronicles
11.fullDescription:
Embark on a journey through a world governed by the roll of the dice. Build your deck of powerful dice, battle monsters, and uncover the secrets of the Dicefall.
      Every roll matters in this roguelike adventure. Strategize your moves, manage your dice pool, and adapt to the ever-changing challenges of the dungeon.
      Unlock new characters with unique abilities and discover rare dice that can turn the tide of battle. Can you master the chaos and become the champion of Alea?
11.tips: Balance your dice pool between attack and defense. Save your special abilities for boss fights.
11.lore: In the realm of Alea, chance is the only law. The Dicefall event shattered reality, and now only those who can master the dice can survive.

12.title: Heroes of the Last Nexus
12.description: A strategic hero collection RPG where you must gather heroes to defend the Last Nexus.
12.fullDescription: In a dying world, the Last Nexus is all that remains. You are a Soul-Binder tasked with summoning legendary heroes to protect this final bastion against the encroaching darkness. Gather your team, level up your heroes, and face waves of monsters in this epic strategic adventure.
12.controls: Mouse/Touch: Summon heroes and manage your team.
12.tips: Focus on upgrading your tank heroes early. Don't forget to use your Soul-Binder abilities to support your team when things get tough. Synergies between different classes are the key to surviving later waves.
12.lore: The Last Nexus was created by the Ancient Celestials to hold back the Void. For eons, it stood as a beacon of light, but its power is fading. Only the gathering of the Heroes of Legend can restore its strength and push back the darkness once and for all.
features: Epic Boss Battles and Infinite Monster Waves
Deep Hero Progression and Skill Trees
Global Leaderboard for Most Heroes Collected

13.title: Timing Chef
13.description: Master the art of perfect timing in the kitchen!
13.fullDescription:
Step into the shoes of an aspiring chef where precision is everything. In Timing Chef, your goal is to cook various dishes to perfection by hitting the sweet spot. 
      Manage multiple orders, watch your heat levels, and serve up culinary masterpieces to hungry customers. 
      As you progress, unlock new recipes and upgrade your kitchen equipment to handle the dinner rush. Can you earn the elusive five-star rating and become the ultimate Timing Chef?
13.controls: Mouse/Touch: Click or tap to start and stop cooking actions.
13.tips: Pay close attention to the visual and audio cues. Each ingredient has its own 'perfect' window. Don't let the heat build up too much, or you'll burn the dish!
13.lore:
In the high-stakes world of competitive cooking, a single second can be the difference between a Michelin star and a kitchen disaster. 
      The legendary 'Timing Chef' was said to be able to hear the exact moment a steak reached medium-rare from across the room. 
      Do you have the senses and the nerves to follow in their footsteps?
features: Variety of Unlockable Recipes and Cuisines
Kitchen Upgrade System for Faster Cooking
Aesthetic Pixel Art and Satisfying Sound Effects

14.title: Fruit Frenzy
14.description: A juicy and addictive arcade game where you collect fruits to complete your encyclopedia!
14.fullDescription: In Fruit Frenzy, your goal is to collect as many fruits as possible to unlock all entries in the legendary Encyclopedia. Each fruit you collect brings you closer to becoming the ultimate Fruit Master. Watch out for special frenzy modes and aim for the highest score!
14.controls: Mouse/Touch: Click or tap to collect fruits.
14.tips: Unlock new fruits in the encyclopedia to boost your score multiplier. During frenzy mode, all fruit values are doubled!
14.lore: The Orchard of Abundance has overflowed with magic, causing the fruits to take on a life of their own. As the chosen Harvester, you must document every variety and maintain the balance of the orchard.
features: Global Leaderboard: Encyclopedia Count & Best Score

15.title: Kingdom's Last Stand
15.description: A strategic auto-battler roguelike where you build your army, manage formations, and defend your kingdom against endless waves of enemies.
15.fullDescription:
The kingdom is on the brink of collapse. As the last commander, you must assemble a ragtag army and hold the line against relentless enemy forces pouring through the breach.
      Kingdom's Last Stand is a deep auto-battler roguelike that combines tactical positioning with elemental strategy. Place your units across three rows — front, middle, and back — and watch as they fight automatically based on their abilities and formation.
      Manage your gold economy wisely between rounds. Recruit powerful heroes, upgrade your forces, and exploit elemental interactions between Fire, Nature, Lightning, and Ice to turn the tide of battle.
      Each stage brings tougher foes and new challenges. How far can you push before the kingdom falls?
15.controls: Mouse Click: Select and place units / Drag: Rearrange formation / UI Buttons: Buy, upgrade, start battle
15.tips: Balance your gold between recruiting new units and upgrading existing ones. Position tanky units in the front row to protect your fragile damage dealers in the back. Pay attention to elemental interactions — Fire beats Nature, Nature beats Lightning, Lightning beats Ice, and Ice beats Fire. Don't rush through rounds; take time to optimize your formation.
15.lore:
For a thousand years, the Kingdom of Aethermoor stood as a bastion against the darkness beyond the Veil. Its arcane wards, powered by the four Elemental Crystals, kept the realm safe.
      But treachery struck from within. The Court Mage shattered the Crystals, and the Veil tore open. Now hordes of corrupted beasts and fallen warriors pour through, each wave stronger than the last.
      You are the Shield-Captain, chosen by the dying king with his last breath. With nothing but a handful of loyal soldiers and the scattered shards of the Crystals, you must hold the line.
      Rally the remnants. Harness the elements. This is the kingdom's last stand.

16.title: Triangle Battle!
16.description: A fast-paced local multiplayer arcade game where 1-4 players compete to form triangles and outsmart each other.
16.fullDescription:
Triangle Battle! is a vibrant local multiplayer arcade game designed for 1 to 4 players on a single device. The goal is simple — form triangles faster than your opponents — but the competition is fierce.
      Players move across the board, claiming points and strategically blocking each other. Quick reflexes and spatial awareness are the keys to victory. The game supports both keyboard and touch controls, making it perfect for any device.
      Whether you're playing solo to practice or battling friends on the couch, Triangle Battle! delivers fast rounds, colorful visuals, and endless replayability. Gather your friends and find out who's the triangle champion!
16.controls: Player 1: WASD / Player 2: Arrow Keys / Player 3-4: On-screen touch buttons / Mobile: Touch controls for all players
16.tips: Focus on claiming corner positions early — they give you more triangle-forming opportunities. Watch your opponents' movements and block their potential triangles before they complete them. In 3-4 player games, temporary alliances can help you take down the leader.
16.lore:
In the neon-lit arenas of the Grid, geometric warriors compete for supremacy. The ancient Triangle Protocol demands that only those who can form the perfect shape will ascend.
      Each match is a test of speed, strategy, and spatial mastery. The Grid remembers every triangle ever formed, and the greatest players are immortalized in its luminous halls.

17.title: Tank Battle: 1v1
17.description: Battle against a friend in this intense 1v1 local multiplayer tank arena!
17.fullDescription:
Tank Battle: 1v1 is a fast-paced action game designed for two players on the same screen. Command your tank with precision, use obstacles for cover, and destroy your opponent's tank before they take you down.
      Perfect for casual gaming sessions with friends, this game brings back the classic arcade feel with modern, smooth mechanics. Strategy is key: will you rush your opponent or wait for the perfect shot?
17.controls: Player 1: WASD (Move), Space (Fire) / Player 2: Arrow Keys (Move), Enter (Fire)
17.tips: Use blocks for cover and wait for the right moment. The tanks bounce off walls slightly, so keep moving to avoid becoming an easy target!
17.lore:
The Tank Arena is where true commanders are forged. In a world of steel and smoke, two titans face off for ultimate supremacy. 
      Every shot counts, every move is critical. Only one will emerge victorious from the dust of battle.

18.title: Skyfall
18.description: Dodge the falling obstacles and survive as long as you can in this fast-paced arcade game!
18.fullDescription: Skyfall is a challenging survival arcade game that tests your reflexes and agility. As various objects descend from above, you must navigate through the storm and find the safest path. The intensity increases as you survive longer, pushing your limits. Compete for the highest survival time and master the art of dodging!
18.controls: Left/Right Arrows or A/D to move / Touch buttons on mobile
18.tips: Stay near the center for better movement options. Watch for the shadows to predict where objects will land. Practice makes perfect!

19.title: Spirit Duel
19.description: A tactical 1v1 card-spirit battle game — challenge a friend locally or test your wits against the AI!
19.fullDescription:
Spirit Duel is a deep tactical battle game where players summon powerful spirits and outmaneuver their opponent through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.
      Choose from a roster of unique spirits, each with distinct abilities. Build your strategy, read your opponent, and strike at the perfect moment. Every duel is a fresh test of skill and adaptability.
      Play locally against a friend in intense 1v1 matches, or sharpen your tactics against the AI. The spirits await — who will emerge victorious?
19.controls: Mouse/Touch: Select spirits and actions / UI Buttons: Confirm moves and end turn
19.tips: Learn each spirit's strengths and weaknesses before committing to a strategy. Resource tempo is everything — don't overextend early. Watch your opponent's patterns when facing the AI to find exploitable openings.
19.lore:
Ancient spirits have long walked the boundary between worlds, each one a force of nature given form. In the sacred dueling grounds, two spirit binders face off, their wills clashing through the spirits they command.
      Only through mastery of both spirit and strategy can a true binder claim supremacy. The duel is not just a battle — it is a conversation between souls.
features: Unique Spirit Roster with Distinct Abilities

20.title: Polygon Invasion TD
20.description: A fast-paced tower defense game where you defend against waves of geometric invaders.
20.fullDescription:
Polygon Invasion TD throws you into a vibrant geometric battlefield where waves of polygonal enemies advance relentlessly toward your core. Place towers strategically, upgrade them mid-battle, and adapt your defenses to survive ever-tougher waves.
      Each polygon type brings its own threat — fast triangles, armored hexagons, and swarming squares all demand different counter-strategies. Resource management and tower placement are the keys to climbing further into the invasion.
      How deep can you push? Reach the peak wave, rack up enemy kills, and claim your spot on the global leaderboard.
20.controls: Mouse Click / Touch: Place towers, upgrade, and select targets
20.tips: Cover chokepoints early. Mix tower types — single-target for tanks, splash for swarms. Save resources for emergency upgrades during boss waves.
20.lore:
The Polygon Dimension has breached our reality, and its geometric inhabitants march in endless formation. Only your towers stand between order and the encroaching chaos of shapes.
      Build, upgrade, and hold the line. Every wave repelled is a fragment of reality reclaimed.

21.title: Just Jump
21.description: A simple, addictive jumping arcade game — time your leaps and climb as high as you can.
21.fullDescription:
Just Jump strips the platformer down to its purest form: jump, land, repeat. Time each leap perfectly to clear gaps, stick tricky landings, and push your run further than the last.
      Easy to pick up, hard to master. One mistimed jump and the run ends — but the next attempt is one tap away. Chase a personal best, then chase the global top of the leaderboard.
21.tips: Read the rhythm before reacting — most deaths come from over-jumping. Short hops cover more ground than you think. Keep your eyes on the next platform, not your feet.
21.lore:
No story. No cutscenes. No upgrades. Just you, a platform, and the next jump.
      Every leap is a small bet against gravity. How long can you keep winning?

22.title: Mythic Defender: Heroes Returns
22.description: A card-driven tower defense where mythic heroes return to hold the line against endless legions.
22.fullDescription:
Mythic Defender: Heroes Returns fuses classic tower defense with deck-building strategy. Draw heroes from your card pool, place them along the path, and unleash devastating abilities to crush waves of orcs, demons, and worse.
      Every map is a puzzle of positioning and timing. Some heroes deal heavy single-target damage, others rain area-of-effect lightning, and a few support the whole line with auras. Mix and match to counter what each wave throws at you.
      Earn mana between rounds, upgrade your strongest heroes, and unlock new cards as you progress deeper into the campaign. The legions never stop — how long can your kingdom stand?
22.controls: Mouse: Drag hero cards onto valid tiles, click heroes to upgrade or activate abilities, click UI buttons to start waves and manage your deck.
22.tips: Front-load tanky melee heroes near chokepoints to soak damage while ranged casters work safely from the back. Save mana for the wave's elite enemies — burning everything early leaves you defenseless when the boss arrives. Upgrades scale better than placing more low-tier units; concentrate your firepower.
22.lore:
Once, the Mythic Heroes walked among mortals — Thor of the Storm Hammer, the rune-bound shieldmaidens of the North, the silent archers of the Whispering Wood. When the world found peace, they faded into legend, their cards sealed in the vaults of forgotten kings.
      Now the Burning Horde has torn through the seals, and ancient citadels burn beneath blood-red skies. The cards have begun to glow again. The heroes are returning — but only one defender can summon them.
      You hold the deck. The legions are at the gate.
features: Diverse Hero Roster with Unique Abilities
